notes.title: Patch notes v1.12
notes.content:
Refactored and optimized algorithm for finding intersections.
 Fixed wrong intersections with degenerate arcs.
 Fixed snapping cursor jitter.
 Problem 22: fixed verifier (In some cases the verifier could not find a correct solution).
 Problem 74: fixed verifier (The verifier accepted an incorrect solution).

notes.title: Regular update v 1.1
notes.content:
This update contains the following changes.
[olist]
 Added progress tracking. All solved problems are marked with a checkmark in the list of all problems. (The show solution button must not be used.)
 Added support for fullscreen mode. You can press ALT+ENTER to switch the game into full screen view or click the "Fullscreen" button in Settings.
 Reworked descriptions of some problems.
 Simplified solutions to some problems.
 Fixed various smaller issues and typos
[/olist]
